question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The cat’s entry into the store room was ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"quiet"** means making little or no noise; silent or calm. (शांत)

 
 
• **Example: **The library was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.
 
 
 
• **"Quiet" **suggests an absence of noise or activity, which fits the context of the cat's stealthy entry. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example: **The quiet cat slipped into the room without anyone noticing.
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence is: The cat’s entry into the store room was **quiet**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Quit** (छोड़ देना): To leave or give up.

 
 
• **Example: **He decided to quit his job to pursue his passion for painting.
 
 
 
• **Quite** (काफी): To a certain or significant extent.
 
 
• **Example: **She is quite talented in playing the piano.
 
 
 
• **Cute** (प्यारा): Attractive in a pretty or endearing way.
 
 
• **Example: **The kitten looked very cute as it played with the yarn.
